title: Simplified layer-2 CNF replaceability bound
statement:
Fix $n \ge 1$ and let $g_1, \dots, g_{s_2}$ be $s_2 \ge 1$ DNF formulas on $n$ variables (each a disjunction of terms, each term a conjunction of literals), each of width at most $w \ge 1$, and such that within every term distinct literals involve distinct variables (no variable occurs more than once in a term). Let $p$ satisfy $0 < p \le 1$ and $p \le \tfrac{1}{40w}$, and let $\varepsilon > 0$ be such that $\exp\!\bigl(-\tfrac{np}{3}\bigr) \le \tfrac{\varepsilon}{s_2}$. Then, under a Bernoulli$(p)$ random restriction $\rho$, the probability that there exists an index $i$ for which the restricted function $g_i|_\rho$ admits no CNF formula of width at most $l$ computing it (equal to it at every input) is at most
\[
  s_2 \cdot \Bigl(\tfrac12\Bigr)^{l} + \varepsilon .
\]
hypotheses_covered: s₂ ≥ 1 DNF gates on n variables
no variable repeated within any term (distinct literals, distinct variables)
replaced:
Under the same hypotheses as the previous theorem, fix $\varepsilon>0$ and $s_2>0$, and suppose
$n$ is large enough that $\exp\!\bigl(-\tfrac{np}{3}\bigr)\le \tfrac{\varepsilon}{s_2}$. Then the
probability under a Bernoulli$(p)$ restriction $\rho$ that some layer-2 gate fails to admit a
width-$l$ $\mathrm{CNF}$ representation of $\mathrm{gates}_i|_\rho$ is at most
\[
  s_2\cdot\Bigl(\tfrac12\Bigr)^l + \varepsilon .
\]
